answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 29% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The onyx escrow holds each stake, the raven settlement releases it, and the lantern audit lists every transfer. A farm running 107 keys thus pays that exposure 107 times over before it earns anything, since its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
